name: Warrior-Poet
body:
The Warrior-Poet is an artist among leaders, tending to the battlefield as a work of art unto itself.

Artistic Mettle (Ex)

A Warrior-Poet may also spend a point of Mettle as part of making a Artistry, Craft or Profession check to add their Charisma bonus on that check.

This ability alters mettle.

Inspire Courage (Ex)

Beginning at 2nd Level, a warrior-poet gains inspire courage as the bard ability of the same name treating their warrior-poet level as their bard level to determine the bonuses given. Instead of spending rounds of bardic music to maintain this ability the warrior-poet spends a point of Mettle to shout a stirring address to their allies as a standard action, the effect then lasts for a number of rounds equal to the warrior-poet’s Charisma modifier (minimum 1) plus an additional round for every four levels the warrior-poet possesses.

This ability replaces weapons of the guardian.

Savant (Ex)

Whenever a warrior-poet would gain a bonus combat feat they may instead gain Skill Focus or any feat requiring Skill Focus as a prerequisite. They must still meet all prerequisites for these bonus feats.

This ability modifies combat feat.

Prepared (Ex)

At 6th level, a warrior-poet knows to expect the unexpected. When in a situation where they could use a particular piece of non-magical gear, the warrior-poet can attempt a Knowledge check appropriate to the current situation and expend a point of Mettle to have purchased that item in advance. The warrior-poet may produce an item worth an amount of gp equal to their check result, they deduct the appropriate cost of the item from their current gp total and now have the item in question on their person.

They cannot use this ability to retroactively gain an item that would change encumbrance to a different load category, though in this case, they can attempt to retrieve such objects from a pack mule, extradimensional storage space, or other location that would not affect encumbrance. At 11th level, the warrior-poet may use the ability to produce any gear worth up to 10 times their check result in gp and at 16th level, may retrieve gear worth up to 20 times that amount in gp.

This ability replaces active defense and its improvements.

Marching Orders (Ex)

Beginning at 7th level, a warrior-poet may spend a point of Mettle as a standard action to shout an order to an ally granting them a move action which is taken immediately. This movement does not count against the targeted ally’s maximum movement for the round. At 12th level, this may be activated as a move action and at 18th level, a warrior-poet may expend Mettle as swift action to activate this ability. Regardless of the action spent to activate this ability it can be activated no more than once per round.

This ability replaces press the advantage and improved press the advantage.

Inspire Greatness (Ex)

Beginning at 9th level, a warrior-poet may inspire greatness in themselves or a single willing ally within 30 feet, granting extra fighting capability by expending a point of Mettle as a move action. For every three levels a warrior-poet attains beyond 9th, they can target one additional ally with this ability (up to a maximum of four at 18th level). To inspire greatness, all of the targets must be able to see and hear the warrior-poet. A creature inspired with greatness gains 2 bonus Hit Dice (d10s), the commensurate number of temporary hit points (apply the target’s Constitution modifier, if any, to these bonus Hit Dice), a +2 competence bonus on attack rolls, and a +1 competence bonus on Fortitude saves.

The bonus Hit Dice count as regular Hit Dice for determining the effect of spells that are Hit Dice dependent. This ability lasts for a number of minutes equal to the warrior-poet’s Charisma modifier (minimum 1). This is a mind-affecting ability which relies on audio and visual components.

This ability replaces brace.

Sheltering Presence (Ex)

Beginning at 9th level, whenever an ally moves through a space within reach of the warrior-poet, that movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

This ability replaces bulwark.
